label: GO step choosing a2 late in the episode (trial >= ~90), after a rewarded trial
explanation: Fires only at GO steps, and almost only when the agent is about to choose a2 (99% of mass; model_act==2, choice logit strongly negative). It is also gated by episode time: it never fires before trial ~70, and 82% of mass falls in trials 90-99, where the value head output is low (value < 5.2 holds 85% of mass), so it likely tracks an end-of-episode / low-value signal. Previous reward = 1 carries 95% of mass. It never fires at D1 or D2, on a1 choices, or after unrewarded trials (rarely). The only FUTURE variable used is action at GO, which is the agent own upcoming choice and is legitimate; no future reward or transition is used. GO & a2 & trial>=90 gets F1 0.60 and mass recall 0.81; adding prev_reward==1 raises F1 to 0.68 (dev). Precision is limited because the feature ramps up gradually across trials 80-99 and its onset varies by episode, so a fixed trial cutoff is a poor fit. Magnitude grows within a window toward later trials; the largest activations in the top examples come at a2 GO steps just after a rewarded a2 trial late in the episode. That is an observation from the examples, not a quantified check.
